NORTHGATE COMMUNITY SPORTS CLUB
CONSTITUTION AND ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING MINUTES

---

SECTION A – CONSTITUTION (AS AMENDED)

Northgate Community Sports Club founded_year 1974 year. Record status: historical. This date is recorded in the original
founding deed held by the Club Secretary and remains the recognised date of establishment for all
governance purposes.

1. NAME
The Club shall be known as Northgate Community Sports Club (hereafter "the Club").

2. OBJECTS
To promote community participation in healthy recreation, primarily but not exclusively through
football, cricket, and athletics. To provide facilities and coaching for junior and senior members.
To foster good relations between members of the local community.

3. MEMBERSHIP
3.1 Full membership is open to all persons aged 18 and over who support the objects of the Club.
3.2 Junior membership is open to persons aged 8–17. Junior members may not vote at general
meetings.
3.3 Associate membership is available to non-residents and former members, at the discretion of the
Committee.
3.4 The Committee shall have power to refuse or terminate membership for conduct detrimental to
the Club, subject to the right of appeal to the next general meeting.

4. SUBSCRIPTIONS
Annual subscriptions are payable on 1st April each year. The amount shall be proposed by the
Committee and ratified at the Annual General Meeting. Members whose subscriptions remain unpaid
after 31st May shall be deemed lapsed.

5. OFFICERS
The Officers of the Club shall be: Chair, Vice-Chair, Secretary, Treasurer, and Membership
Secretary. Officers are elected annually at the Annual General Meeting and hold office from the
close of that meeting until the close of the next.

6. THE COMMITTEE
6.1 The Committee shall consist of the Officers plus up to six ordinary members, elected at the AGM.
6.2 The Committee shall meet at least six times per year. Minutes of Committee meetings shall be
available to any member on request.
6.3 A quorum for Committee meetings shall be five members, at least two of whom must be Officers.

7. GENERAL MEETINGS
7.1 The Annual General Meeting shall be held in November each year, on a date fixed by the
Committee, with at least 21 days' written notice to members.
7.2 An Extraordinary General Meeting may be called by the Committee, or by a requisition signed by
at least 15 full members, stating the business to be transacted.
7.3 A quorum for an AGM or EGM shall be 20 full members. If a quorum is not present within 30
minutes of the advertised start time, the meeting shall stand adjourned to the same day the following
week, at which time such members as are present shall constitute a quorum.

8. VOTING
8.1 Each full member present shall have one vote. Voting shall be by show of hands unless a ballot
is demanded by at least five members.
8.2 The Chair shall have a casting vote in the event of a tie.

9. FINANCE
9.1 The financial year of the Club shall end on 31st March. The Treasurer shall prepare an annual
statement of accounts, which shall be examined by an independent examiner appointed at the AGM.
9.2 No Officer or Committee member shall receive payment for their services, other than reasonable
out-of-pocket expenses approved by the Committee.

10. AMENDMENTS TO THE CONSTITUTION
Any amendment to this Constitution shall require a two-thirds majority of those present and voting
at a general meeting. Notice of the proposed amendment shall be given in writing at least 14 days
before the meeting.

11. DISSOLUTION
The Club may be dissolved by resolution passed at an Extraordinary General Meeting by a
two-thirds majority of those present and voting. Upon dissolution, any assets remaining after
payment of debts shall be transferred to a charity or community sports organisation with similar
objects, as decided by the meeting.
**2. Chair's Report**
J. Okafor reported on a successful year for the Club. Highlights included:
- The completion of the refurbishment of the changing rooms in the Main Pavilion, funded by the Club's capital reserve and a grant from the Borough Council.
- An increase in junior membership, attributed to the summer holiday coaching programme.
- The continuation of the Thursday evening social league, which now has 14 teams.
- The Club's participation in the Borough Sports Forum, where the Chair represents the Club on the facilities sub-committee.

The Chair thanked the outgoing Committee members for their service and welcomed the new members.

**3. Treasurer's Report and Financial Statements**
T. Bhardwaj presented the audited accounts for the financial year ended 31 March 2023. The full statement of accounts is available for inspection by any member on request.

Net surplus for the year: £510. The balance held at the bank as at 31 March 2023 was £14,780, of which £9,200 is designated for the proposed resurfacing of the tennis courts.

The Treasurer noted that the independent examiner, Mrs. E. Pemberton, had raised no matters of concern. The accounts were approved. Proposed by S. Whitfield, seconded by L. Ferris. Carried unanimously.

**4. Election of Officers and Committee**
The following members were elected to serve for the year 2023–2024. All nominations had been received at least 14 days before the meeting.

- **Chair:** J. Okafor (re-elected)

**5. Appointment of Independent Examiner**
Mrs. E. Pemberton was re-appointed as the independent examiner for the financial year ending 31 March 2024. Proposed by C. Marsh, seconded by R. Calloway. Carried unanimously.

**6. Proposed Amendments to the Constitution**
The Committee had proposed two amendments to the Constitution, for which notice had been given in writing to all members on 20 October 2023.

- **Amendment 1 – Section 5 (Membership):** To clarify that the Committee may, at its discretion, offer a temporary associate membership category for individuals participating in Club-organised courses or events, without the rights of full membership. The amendment was carried with 38 votes in favour, 2 against, and 2 abstentions (exceeding the required two-thirds majority).
- **Amendment 2 – Section 9 (Finance):** To increase the threshold for which the Treasurer must obtain Committee approval for unbudgeted expenditure from £250 to £500. The amendment was carried with 35 votes in favour, 4 against, and 3 abstentions.

**7. Date of Next Annual General Meeting**
It was agreed that the Annual General Meeting 2024 would be scheduled for Friday 15 November 2024, to be held in the Main Pavilion at 7:30 pm, subject to the 21 days' written notice as per the Constitution. The date was set by the Committee on 10 November 2023 and announced to members via the October newsletter and the Club noticeboard. NORTHGATE COMMUNITY SPORTS CLUB
CONSTITUTION AND ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING MINUTES

---

SECTION A – CONSTITUTION (AS AMENDED)

Northgate Community Sports Club founded_year 1974 year. Record status: historical. This date is recorded in the original
founding deed held by the Club Secretary and remains the recognised date of establishment for all
governance purposes.

1. NAME
The Club shall be known as Northgate Community Sports Club (hereafter "the Club").

2. OBJECTS
To promote community participation in healthy recreation, primarily but not exclusively through
football, cricket, and athletics. To provide facilities and coaching for junior and senior members.
To foster good relations between members of the local community.

3. MEMBERSHIP
3.1 Full membership is open to all persons aged 18 and over who support the objects of the Club.
3.2 Junior membership is open to persons aged 8–17. Junior members may not vote at general
meetings.
3.3 Associate membership is available to non-residents and former members, at the discretion of the
Committee.
3.4 The Committee shall have power to refuse or terminate membership for conduct detrimental to
the Club, subject to the right of appeal to the next general meeting.

4. SUBSCRIPTIONS
Annual subscriptions are payable on 1st April each year. The amount shall be proposed by the
Committee and ratified at the Annual General Meeting. Members whose subscriptions remain unpaid
after 31st May shall be deemed lapsed.

5. OFFICERS
The Officers of the Club shall be: Chair, Vice-Chair, Secretary, Treasurer, and Membership
Secretary. Officers are elected annually at the Annual General Meeting and hold office from the
close of that meeting until the close of the next.

6. THE COMMITTEE
6.1 The Committee shall consist of the Officers plus up to six ordinary members, elected at the AGM.
6.2 The Committee shall meet at least six times per year. Minutes of Committee meetings shall be
available to any member on request.
6.3 A quorum for Committee meetings shall be five members, at least two of whom must be Officers.

7. GENERAL MEETINGS
7.1 The Annual General Meeting shall be held in November each year, on a date fixed by the
Committee, with at least 21 days' written notice to members.
7.2 An Extraordinary General Meeting may be called by the Committee, or by a requisition signed by
at least 15 full members, stating the business to be transacted.
7.3 A quorum for an AGM or EGM shall be 20 full members. If a quorum is not present within 30
minutes of the advertised start time, the meeting shall stand adjourned to the same day the following
week, at which time such members as are present shall constitute a quorum.

8. VOTING
8.1 Each full member present shall have one vote. Voting shall be by show of hands unless a ballot
is demanded by at least five members.
8.2 The Chair shall have a casting vote in the event of a tie.

9. FINANCE
9.1 The financial year of the Club shall end on 31st March. The Treasurer shall prepare an annual
statement of accounts, which shall be examined by an independent examiner appointed at the AGM.
9.2 No Officer or Committee member shall receive payment for their services, other than reasonable
out-of-pocket expenses approved by the Committee.

10. AMENDMENTS TO THE CONSTITUTION
Any amendment to this Constitution shall require a two-thirds majority of those present and voting
at a general meeting. Notice of the proposed amendment shall be given in writing at least 14 days
before the meeting.

11. DISSOLUTION
The Club may be dissolved by resolution passed at an Extraordinary General Meeting by a
two-thirds majority of those present and voting. Upon dissolution, any assets remaining after
payment of debts shall be transferred to a charity or community sports organisation with similar
objects, as decided by the meeting.
